user.title: Lawn Growth
user.description: Where the model gets its weather, and how it reaches you.

data_description.weather_entity: Supplies today's high/low and the 10-day forecast.
data_description.season_entity: Optional. When off, the lawn is out of season. Leave empty for always in season.
data_description.notify_service: Optional. Where mow-due, first-mow and overseed pushes go.
data_description.run_time: When the day's growth is added and pushes are sent.

area_basics.title: Mowing area
area_basics.description: A mowing area is a stretch of lawn you mow together, for example 'Front & Side' and 'Back'. Set up one now; add more later under Configure → Add a mowing area. Each mowing area becomes its own device with its own advice.

area_details.title: {name}
area_details.description: Defaults come from the grass type; change anything. After this step, Home Assistant lists the new devices. Assigning them to a Home Assistant area is optional and doesn't affect mowing advice.

data_description.moisture_sensors: Averaged. GeoDrops sensors are quality-checked automatically.
data_description.wilting_moisture: Moisture reading where growth stops (GeoDrops index default 40). For a volumetric % sensor, use its dry reading.
data_description.comfortable_moisture: Moisture reading with no water stress (GeoDrops index default 67). For a volumetric % sensor, use its field-capacity reading.
data_description.mow_source_entity: Optional. For mowers Home Assistant can't see: an entity that changes after each mow, such as a counter that goes up by one. Leave empty if you'll set up a robot mower under Configure → Mower settings.
data_description.mower_locations: Pick the mower location names that are inside this mowing area. Type a name if it isn't listed.

error.cut_range: The highest cut height must be above the lowest.
error.overseed_target: The overseed target must be below the highest cut height.
error.moisture_band: Full-growth moisture must be above the growth-stops value.
error.location_in_use: A mower location can belong to only one area.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name for the mowing area.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Lawn Growth is already set up. Add mowing areas from its Configure menu.

mower.title: Mower settings
mower.description: Optional. Lets Lawn Growth log mows (and the blade height) itself, however the mower was started. Clear the activity entity to turn this off.

data.min_area_minutes: Minimum time in an area to count (minutes)

data_description.activity_entity: The mower's state or activity entity.
data_description.working_states: The states that mean the mower is cutting. Include paused states so a pause doesn't split a run.
data_description.blade_entity: A sensor reporting the cutting height the mower is set to.
data_description.location_entity: A sensor that names where the mower is working right now, such as 'Backyard' or 'Front Yard' (on a Mammotion/Luba it's the work area sensor). After saving, open Configure → Edit a mowing area and pick which of these names belong to each area. Names not assigned to any area, like 'path' or 'Not working', are ignored.

log_mow.name: Log mow
log_mow.description: Record a mow for the targeted mowing areas.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to log this mow for.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the mow. Defaults to today.

height_in.name: Cut height
height_in.description: Height the lawn was cut to. Defaults to the last cut height.

correct_last_mow.name: Correct last mow
correct_last_mow.description: Fix the cut height recorded for the most recent mow.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to correct the last mow for.

height_in.name: Cut height
height_in.description: The height the lawn was actually cut to.

log_seeding.name: Log seeding
log_seeding.description: Record a seeding; mowing is held until the seedlings are ready.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to log this seeding for.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of seeding. Defaults to today.

seedlings_ready.name: Seedlings ready
seedlings_ready.description: Confirm the new grass is ready for its first mow.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas whose seedlings are ready.

log_event.name: Log fertilizer or PGR
log_event.description: Record a fertilizer or plant-growth-regulator application.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to apply this to.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of application. Defaults to today.

prep_overseed.name: Prepare for overseeding
prep_overseed.description: Step the cut height down to the overseed target ahead of a seed date.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to prepare for overseeding.

target_in.name: Target height
target_in.description: Height to reach before seeding. Defaults to the area's overseed target.

buffer_days.name: Buffer days
buffer_days.description: Reach the target this many days before the seed date. Default 7.

cancel_overseed.name: Cancel overseed prep
cancel_overseed.description: Stop preparing the targeted mowing areas for overseeding.

device_id.name: Mowing area
device_id.description: The mowing areas to cancel overseed prep for.

evaluate_now.name: Evaluate now
evaluate_now.description: Re-run the growth model now and send any due notifications.

options.number_increases: A number that goes up after each mow
